annotations.title: Net salary: United States vs the Netherlands

description: Take-home pay of a job in United States (with the situation options of net_salary) next to a job in the Netherlands (2026, optionally with the 8% holiday allowance and the 30% ruling), in euros, with the difference a year.

age.description: Age; changes the result here (young-worker reliefs, senior slabs, surcharges). Default 35.

filing.description: Filing status (unmarried). Married people file jointly here; switch on "Married" above.: single = Single; hoh = Head of household (with a qualifying child). Default single.

fx_per_eur.description: Exchange rate: 1 euro = this many USD, for the euro amounts. Default 1.08 (indicative).

home_gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in United States, in USD

hsa.description: HSA contribution. Health Savings Account, 2026 limit $4,400 self-only, $8,750 family. Free of income tax and FICA through payroll. ($ / year). Default 0.

married.description: Married or registered partner. Default false.

nl_gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in the Netherlands, in euros, without holiday allowance

nl_holiday_allowance.description: The Dutch job pays 8% holiday allowance on top. Default true.

nl_thirty_percent_ruling.description: The 30% ruling applies in the Netherlands. Default false.

pension_pct.description: Voluntary employee pension contribution through payroll, % of salary. Default 0.

pretax.description: Other pre-tax deductions. Employee share of health premiums, FSA, commuter benefits (section 125): free of income tax and FICA. ($ / year). Default 0.

spouse_income.description: Partner's gross yearly income in USD, for joint taxation and spouse allowances. Default 0.

state.description: State: none = No state income tax (TX, FL, NV, TN, SD, WY, AK, NH); CA = California; NY = New York (outside NYC); NYC = New York City; IL = Illinois (4.95% flat); MA = Massachusetts (5%, 9% above $1.08M); PA = Pennsylvania (3.07% flat); NJ = New Jersey; CO = Colorado (4.4% flat); NC = North Carolina (3.99% flat); GA = Georgia (4.99% flat); AZ = Arizona (2.5% flat); WA = Washington (no income tax, WA Cares + PFML). Default none.
